fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CRB CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: TYPE OF SERVICES OFFERED
fields.description: Type of Services offered by the Agent category. E.g. {Delivery of credit reports,certificates and scores to requesting customers; sensitize customers, institutions, and other credit information providers; receive and channel customer complaints}

fields.name: NO OF SERVICES OFFERED
fields.description: The count on the number of services offered per type of service
